items.problem: A copied UWP manifest could pass validation but crash packaged WinUI activation, and an unpackaged workaround could silently suppress the build manifest.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered for COMException 0x8001010E; skill-coverage-gaps.json item 1; migration-score.json candidate_launch_status failed.
items.root_cause: The correct manifest entry-point and packaging-mode rules existed only as prose; the mandatory validator did not enforce them.
items.change: Validate every Application uses EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$" and reject WindowsPackageType=None when Package.appxmanifest is retained. Tier 1 is preferred because prose was already correct and was ignored.
items.expected_effect: The migration cannot reach a clean validation result with the activation-breaking manifest or contradictory package mode.
items.falsifiable_check: On a rerun or fixture with a literal <Namespace>.App entry point and WindowsPackageType=None, Validate-UwpMigration reports both failures before smoke launch; after correction, neither failure appears.

items.problem: The launch helper missed default SDK output and gave a generic hint for a known manifest-activation signature.
items.evidence: lessons.json tools_problematic and dev_agent_struggles; session-log turns 65 and 69-71.
items.root_cause: The helper encoded one bin path convention and classified only the outer CLR exception code.
items.change: Discover the newest directory under bin containing an executable plus AppxManifest.xml, centralize validator discovery through target mode, and recognize the Application.Start apartment message.
items.expected_effect: A normal default build is diagnosable without an extra platform build, and this activation failure points directly to the manifest invariant.
items.falsifiable_check: Given a packaged default dotnet build outside bin\x64\Debug, Test-AppLaunch resolves its layout; given the recorded WER message, its JSON hint names EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$".

items.problem: The WMC9999 guidance asserted a unique root cause that the trial disproved.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 2 and session-log build errors in turns 40-57.
items.root_cause: The documentation confused a generic markup-compiler cascade with a diagnostic.
items.change: Correct the existing paragraph to prioritize specific CS####/WMC#### errors and audit resources only when WMC9999 remains alone. A lower tier cannot reliably infer the root cause from this compiler's generic secondary error.
items.expected_effect: Agents stop making speculative resource edits while actionable compiler errors remain.
items.falsifiable_check: On a rerun with WMC9999 plus explicit errors, the agent fixes the explicit errors first and does not start a resource-key search unless WMC9999 persists.
